module: Small utility of the Easy Select tool: computes the text displayed to name a scene object. Priority: object name, internal name, asset file name (field shapeName or getModelFile), otherwise "Class #id". A prefix indicates the type: [p] Prefab/PrefabInstance, [s] TSStatic, [v] BeamNGVehicle.

objectName.desc: Returns an object's label. If objectId is provided, the object is retrieved via scenetree.findObjectById; if it no longer exists, returns "deleted #id" (or "missing" if no id).

obj.desc: Scene object (ignored if objectId is given)

objectId.desc: Id of the object to retrieve in scenetree
